description: This file defines the DropButton feature for Drupal, including the DropButton class, behaviors for attaching the feature, and theme functions for rendering toggle elements.

classes.name: DropButton
classes.description: A class representing a dropbutton component with methods to toggle, open, close, and handle hover and focus events.

methods.name: DropButton
methods.description: Constructor for the DropButton class, initializes the dropbutton element with settings.

methods.name: dropbuttonClickHandler
methods.description: Handles click events to toggle the dropdown menu.
